note: Cross-category signals per household: canonical life events, behavioral patterns, risk flags, and a financial posture summary. Confidence bands (high/medium/low) mirror the production lifestyle/risk detectors. These are the evidence the Coworker cites. Every household carries at least two signals so no digest row rests on a single balance the advisor can already see. Risk flags are exclusions the institution applies, not determinations Ventus makes. Households also carry a share of the 55-product bank catalog’s vocabulary (snake_case tokens such as college_bound, job_change, rollover_401k, grocery_heavy_spend), authored with the same evidence discipline so the catalog’s newer products have something to fire on until detection emits those tokens itself.
